title: Vintage Graffiti Doodle Symbols Vector
author: sipanji figuree
description:
Vintage Graffiti Doodle Symbols Vector Icon Set is a bold collection of 20 retro-inspired urban doodle graphics designed with expressive hand-drawn lines, sketch textures, and classic street art aesthetics. Featuring a combination of dripping graffiti details, rough marker strokes, and vintage underground vibes, this vector icon pack delivers authentic creative energy for modern design projects.
Inside this collection you will find unique doodle-style elements including hearts, stars, flames, lightning bolts, speech bubbles, smiley faces, cameras, crowns, skulls, arrows, bombs, eyes, music notes, locks, spray paint cans, clouds, broken hearts, hand signs, sparkle bursts, and urban sketch accents. Every icon is carefully illustrated with a raw handcrafted appearance that captures the spirit of old-school street culture and retro graffiti art.
These graphics are ideal for sticker packs, apparel designs, poster layouts, album covers, skate branding, tattoo concepts, social media graphics, notebook decorations, scrapbook projects, streetwear collections, digital art compositions, gaming visuals, and print-on-demand products. The vintage doodle style adds playful character while maintaining strong urban visual appeal.
Each design comes in fully editable vector format, making it easy to resize, recolor, and customize for both digital and print use. Compatible with Adobe Illustrator, CorelDRAW, Canva, Affinity Designer, Cricut Design Space, and other popular design software, this icon set works perfectly for creators looking to build eye-catching urban-inspired artwork.
The retro graffiti influence combined with sketch doodle textures creates a versatile collection suitable for contemporary youth culture themes, underground art concepts, rebellious branding, and nostalgic street aesthetics. The bold black linework and hand-drawn imperfections help give every icon an authentic artistic feel.
Included file formats: SVG and EPS editable vector files.
